content.title: Texas Rangers vs Los Angeles Dodgers Live Stream: How to Watch MLB
content.text: The Texas Rangers and Los Angeles Dodgers face off on Sunday in MLB action. Dodger Stadium is set to host the exciting weekend matchup between the Texas Rangers and the Los Angeles Dodgers on Sunday in MLB regular-season action. The two teams opened the series on Friday night with a thrilling 8-7 finish in favor of the back-to-back reigning World Series champion Dodgers at home. Max Muncy ended the game in dramatic fashion and made history along the way as he became only the second Dodger in history to hit three home runs, including a walk-off, joining Don Demeter (April 21, 1959). The second three-homer game of his career also snapped a three-game winning streak for the Rangers, who were fresh off of a sweep over the Seattle Mariners in Texas to start the week.
